verdicts.reason: A: the product can is shrunk to a tiny scrap, and the Shop Sale button covers most of it and its circle, so the hero image is lost. Everything is crammed into the top third, leaving about 55% of the canvas empty above the tiny legal line. B rearranges the design properly for the tall shape: headline, then CTA, then a large product, then the legal line, in the original colours. Its flaws: '20% off' runs almost to the right edge, the purple circle sits awkwardly behind the headline instead of framing the product, the legal text is too big compared with the subhead, and the left margin is uneven.
